articles.title: Enroll for PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat Health Scheme) for West Bengal Circle 2026
articles.summary: The article details eligibility for the Ayushman Bharat Health Schemes, including the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY). This crucial government initiative offers cashless medical services up to ₹5 lakh, aiming to provide comprehensive health coverage to eligible citizens. Understanding such national welfare programs is vital for SSB aspirants' general awareness and current affairs knowledge.

articles.title: Fatah-3 vs BrahMos: Why Pakistan can't match India's missile edge
articles.summary: This article analyzes India's superior missile capabilities, specifically contrasting the BrahMos with Pakistan's Fatah-3. It explains why India maintains a significant strategic edge in missile technology and operational readiness. For SSB aspirants, this underscores the importance of India's indigenous defence advancements and robust deterrence posture, highlighting critical aspects of national security and military prowess in the region.

articles.title: Lanterns will be the first story on the DCU timeline thanks to a flashback storyline in 2016
articles.summary: The 'Lanterns' TV series will be the first story in the new DC Universe timeline, establishing its foundational chronology. It employs a dual-timeline narrative, with events set a decade in the past and a main plot in 2016. This series is crucial for understanding the updated DCU's intricate temporal structure, offering fans a detailed introduction.

articles.title: Drones, UAS no longer just eyes in sky, but like 'claws in the sky': Air Chief Marshal A P Singh
articles.summary: IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal A P Singh emphasized the transformative role of drones and unmanned aerial systems. He stated they're no longer just "eyes in the sky" for surveillance, but have evolved into "claws in the sky," signifying their enhanced offensive capabilities. This shift highlights their increasing integration into modern warfare strategies, presenting new challenges and opportunities for defence forces.

articles.title: Ancient artifacts found beneath Cape Canaveral Space Force Station as one mystery still stumps researchers
articles.summary: University of Central Florida students and faculty are conducting archaeological excavations at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. They are uncovering historical remnants, revealing a deeper past at a site primarily known for its futuristic space endeavors. This work highlights the rich, layered history embedded within key US military and scientific installations, providing valuable insights into earlier human activities in the region.

articles.title: Preparing Australian industry to support the Virginia class submarine combat system
articles.summary: Australia's Albanese Government has advanced the AUKUS security pact, selecting Lockheed Martin for a significant role. This development, announced by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Defence Richard Marles MP on May 15, 2026, marks a crucial step in bolstering defence capabilities and strategic partnerships. It underscores the ongoing commitment to the trilateral agreement aimed at enhancing regional stability.

articles.title: New Lanterns Season 2 Update Is Amazing News for Green Lantern Fans
articles.summary: HBO and DC are reportedly planning a multi-season future for their upcoming 'Lanterns' series, set in the Green Lantern universe. Although the show has not yet premiered, comments from showrunner Chris Mundy indicate significant studio confidence in its long-term potential. This suggests a substantial investment in expanding the popular comic book franchise for a global audience.
